question: Do the 2008 control marks prefer the VENDOR's delivered ground surface, our CSF reconstruction, or our class-2 reconstruction -- and does the answer depend on land cover?

inputs.role: bridge arm with ground_source=csf; supplies bridge_mm per mark
bridge arm with ground_source=class2; IDENTICAL in every other parameter, so the arms differ only in ground selection
gen1's own 2008 control; dnr_error_m is the REPORT's own Control Z - Surface Z against the DELIVERED surface

params.name: ground_source
params.why: THE variable under test. Andy: 'CSF might be better than the vendor's surface.' Every other parameter is held identical

params.name: covers
params.why: widened from the standing open-ground-only datum rule SO THAT the canopy case is visible -- a vendor classifier's hard cases are vegetated, and an L1O-only comparison cannot see them. A GROUPING here, not a filter: every mark in both arms is reported

params.name: csf_half_width_m
params.why: CSF window half-width; wide enough that the cloth is not dominated by a crop edge. Crops the class2 arm IDENTICALLY, so the windows match

params.name: radii_m
params.why: order-2 fit radius, swept not chosen; a 5 m grid needs 6+ cells to fill one, which sets the floor. Identical in both arms

params.name: lateral_nuth_kaab
params.why: gen1->gen2 registration, needing gen2 which is not on disk away from Elba; measured effect on a tie 10.0 mm. It applies EQUALLY to both arms so it CANCELS in the csf-vs-class2 contrast, and remains in each arm's offset against the marks

params.name: outlier_rule
params.why: no mark is cut. Skew and the extremes are printed so the decision of whether to cut, and where, stays Andy's

masks.name: paired
masks.defn: marks present in BOTH arms AND carrying the report's own dnr_error_m. 0 absent from the class2 arm, 0 carry no dnr_error_m; both counts are reported, never silently dropped

columns.offset_vendor_mm: surveyed - z_delivered = dnr_error_m*1000; the DNR's own number against the DELIVERED class-2 surface. Positive = the surface reads LOW at the mark
columns.z_class2_minus_z_csf_mm: bridge_csf - bridge_class2, mm. The ground-source contrast with nothing else in it. Positive = the class-2 surface sits ABOVE the CSF surface
columns.sd: sample standard deviation over marks, ddof=1, mm -- the NON-absorbable part. A constant mean offset is a datum constant and is removed downstream; scatter is not
columns.nmad: 1.4826 * median absolute deviation, mm; shown beside sd so a difference driven by one mark is visible without cutting it

headline: n=88 paired marks; sd of the offset about its own mean: vendor 100.0, csf 11946.2, class2 11952.7 mm; ground-source contrast (z_class2-z_csf) +1.6 +/- 43.7 mm
